gaps.explanation: Statement (GAAP Governmental Funds statement, trimmed p5) Total Revenue 712,680 = General 491,824 + Economic Development Sales Tax 53,463 + Street 167,393 + Nonmajor 0. Detail = the Budgetary Comparison Schedule (Budgetary Basis), p12-13: General Total Revenues 462,955 + Economic Development Sales Tax 53,830 + Street 165,305 = 682,090. Gap 30,590 = General 28,869 (491,824 - 462,955; e.g. Taxes 151,092 vs Property Taxes 152,246, Intergovernmental 37,187 vs 64,795, Charges 82,570 vs 82,677) + EDST -367 (53,463 - 53,830) + Street 2,088 (167,393 - 165,305). Nonmajor has no revenue. Budgetary (cash) vs GAAP basis; no fix.

Statement p5 Total Expenditures 771,536 = General 552,645 + EDST 121,243 + Street 94,723 + Nonmajor 2,925. The Nonmajor column (Debt Service Principal Retirements 2,021, Interest 904) has no schedule and is not in detail: add both lines (+2,925). The rest is budgetary vs GAAP: budgetary schedule (p12-13) Total Disbursements General 558,770, EDST 135,858, Street 96,852 = 791,480 vs GAAP 552,645 + 121,243 + 94,723 = 768,611 (difference -22,869 = -6,125 - 14,615 - 2,129). Check: 791,480 + 2,925 - 22,869 (basis) = 771,536. The added lines fix the missing-column part (2,925) exactly; the remaining -22,869 is different basis and has no fix.
